channel.title: Cheryl's Newscast
channel.description: Three short news briefings a day — morning, midday, evening — read by Cheryl Tunt in her trademark deadpan. Private feed.
channel.itunes:author: Topher

item.title: Midday briefing — Monday, October 12
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: Saudi Arabia update — Houthi airport attacks cancel 1,000+ flights; Trump–Putin diesel deal draws bipartisan objection • Panama earthquake: 200+ aftershocks, state of emergency, $100M relief, US aid team • North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles toward eastern waters • Nobel economics: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford, for stabilization models • Erie, PA mass shooting: grandfather kills 8 family and friends, then himself • Judge orders halt to taxpayer-funded ads promoting the president • Economic week: big bank earnings kick off, CPI lands Wednesday • Unhinged fun fact: the Macalester serial-sprinkler professor • Amazon–Decart $7B deal: new details — Anthropic walked away in August • Apple announcement Tuesday: new Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini • Valve's Deadlock passes Team Fortress 2's all-time Steam player peak • Retro: Taki Udon's $20 SuperStation memory card — yes, it plays DOOM • Cloudflare acquires the Deno team to expand self-hosted Workers • Voice corner: Suno Speech — spoken voice plus background music in one track • Stocks: DDOG $289.68 down 1.2%; MSFT +0.8%; AAPL +1%; META +3.9%; AMZN flat; NFLX +1.5%; GOOGL +1% • Local: Draper breaks ground on IMPACT microelectronics building in Lowell, 100+ jobs • Local: Highlands RMV Real ID rush; mail-in ballots out, early voting underway

item.title: Morning briefing — Monday, October 12
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Lead: overnight fire destroys Paris's Marché des Enfants-Rouges, the 1615 covered market • World: second strike hits Riyadh airport; schools go remote, US may join retaliation • World: magnitude 7.6 earthquake hits Panama • World: devastating floods along Nepal's Budhi Gandaki River • US: Hurricane Isaias — 4 dead, hundreds of thousands without power across FL, AL, GA • US: Trump announces White House hearing into Fed governor Lisa Cook • US: Pennsylvania measles tops 1,000 cases; state and CDC dispute the death count • Fun fact: a man dressed as Batman chased down a handbag thief in Norwich, England • Tech: Amazon reportedly in talks to buy AI startup Decart for ~$7B • Tech: the AI memory crunch — iPhone 18 Pro component cuts, PC shipments down 20%+ • Gaming: new Castlevania Belmont's Curse launches this week in time for Halloween • Gaming: Wing Commander 3 remaster reportedly announced at Portland Retro Gaming Expo • Homelab: XDA on an unofficial Home Assistant integration that manages Proxmox • Voice: Nvidia open-sources PersonaPlex full-duplex voice AI; Whistle, a 16.9MB CPU speech model • Stocks: Datadog pops 7.1% on Friday; plus Friday closes for AMC, Microsoft, Netflix, Apple, Disney, Alphabet, Dow, Roku, Meta • Local: Tyler Park's brand-new cement corners vandalized overnight in Lowell Highlands • Local: Lowell School Committee rates Superintendent Liam Skinner proficient 6-0, opens contract talks • Sports: Patriots 45, Raiders 17 — Drake Maye throws 5 TDs; UMass Lowell hockey wins 4-2

item.title: Evening briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • The energy ceasefire that lasted hours: Russia hit Ukrainian power plants after Trump's announcement • Saudi Arabia hit by second airport attack; Riyadh airport stays closed, death toll now 13 • Iran sets supertanker ablaze in the Strait of Hormuz after US blockade strike • South Korea tests its first homegrown hypersonic weapon • Hurricane Isaias: 4 dead, flooding rain and tornado risk across Appalachians and mid-Atlantic • DOJ launches largest denaturalization effort in modern history • Massachusetts general election Nov 3: nine ballot questions, early voting starts in six days • Fun fact: Megacauda sungei, the 165-million-year-old mammal that invented multitasking • Waymo closes $5B loan, its first debt financing, to expand the robotaxi fleet • Google launches Project Suncatcher: AI data center hardware tested in orbit • Retro corner: THE 800XL brings the Atari 800XL back with keyboard, cartridges, and HDMI • Battlefield 6 joins Xbox Game Pass on October 13 • Homelab corner: a retired desktop becomes a full Proxmox home server • Voice news: LuxTTS, open-source voice cloning at 150x real-time in under 1GB VRAM • Stocks: markets closed, so here's the week ahead — banks, CPI, TSMC, options expiration • Lowell corner: School Committee rates Superintendent Skinner proficient, approves contract talks • Lowell Asian American Film Festival runs Thursday and Friday at MCC

item.title: Midday briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Trump claims Russia-Ukraine "energy ceasefire" effective immediately • Houthi missile attack kills 12 at Riyadh airport; Saudis close it • Estonia blames Russia for arson at defense supplier • Russia cagey about suspected plague case in Moscow • US-Zambia sign $2.49B health financing pact • Tehran tells Americans directly that "Trump's war has failed" • Trump to decide on livestreaming Nidal Hasan execution • Unhinged fun fact: 57 new deep-sea species off Argentina, including a Patrick Star lookalike • Ukrainian drone strikes cripple Yandex data centers • Nvidia discontinues the RTX 5090 to feed data centers • AI-assisted Daytona USA PC port dev: "Claude turns months into weeks" • New releases: Citadel Forged with Fire; Age of Empires IV Raiders of the North • Homelab corner: Let's Encrypt shortening certs to 64 days in 2027 • Stocks: markets closed Sunday; Datadog at fresh 52-week high • Lowell corner: MAPS loses $214K federal grant for domestic violence program

item.title: Morning briefing — Sunday, October 11
item.description: Stories in this edition: • Erie, PA mass shooting: nine killed, suspected shooter found dead • Stolen car nearly hits the Melbourne Marathon course • Two major earthquakes in Panama, 7.7 and 6.6 • Nobel Peace Prize awarded to Navi Pillay • Turkey bans under-15s from social media • DOJ opens antitrust probe into TV networks' pool-coverage boycott • US sanctions the International Criminal Court • Tax-exempt dyed diesel for farmers through year's end • Unhinged fun fact: 2,700 cats stolen in Ho Chi Minh City • Nadella says treat every AI model as compromised; White House requires AI incident reporting • AI boom squeezes hardware: Apple cuts iPhone 18 Pro orders, PC shipments down, Tencent leases chips • Atari 2600 turns 50 • This week's releases: Dragon's Dogma 2 Dark Arisen, Valor Mortis, Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, Enshrouded 1.0, Ratatan • Homelab corner: Proxmox wired into Home Assistant • OpenAI shutting down its TTS API models in January 2027 • Stocks, Datadog included • Lowell corner: two fire stations closed in staffing crunch • Draper breaks ground on Lowell's IMPACT Center microelectronics building
